## Checklist

- [ ] `__selfTest()` in the browser console reports `Self-test passed`.
- [ ] I played the part I changed (see `docs/TESTING.md`) and saw no console errors.
- [ ] If it changes the UI: I checked about 375 px wide, and with "reduce motion" turned on.
- [ ] If it changes content: I ran any new example or "common slip" myself and the text matches what happens.
- [ ] I updated the README or `docs/` if behaviour, scoring or content changed, including any self-test count.
- [ ] I added a line to `CHANGELOG.md` under `Unreleased`.
